svg.title: Public ratings and the genuine share of stalls, over 30 days without inspectors
svg.desc: Small multiples by whisper rule and switching cost; per-day means over 30 paired seeds with 95% bands, ratings public versus off. The summary gives every value.
svg.text: Public ratings and the genuine share of stalls, over 30 days without inspectors
Ratings effect on late genuine share (whispers allowed, no switch cost): +2.3 points [+0.6, +4.0]
Bazaar engine 0.7.0; no inspectors, naive deceptive sellers. Lines: mean over 30 paired seeds; bands: 95% t-interval per day.
Ratings: memory 0.7, skip threshold 0.5 (placeholders); locals and experts see them. Imitation between days: revise 0.2, mutation 0.02.
